scope: Daily energy minimum (Standards tab G4, C11 and the C11 highlight) after the energy batches 1 and 2 and batch 8c (8g as batch-8.md lists it, pending) of the next version (fragment impl/energy/fragment.json on dump-18OCT26-20261019).

computed_with.sheet: nextbuild/eval/sheval_next.py 2026-10-20.1 (default round_mode decimal15, format_mode decimal15): the template's own formulas (base dump + this fragment)
computed_with.independent_model: impl/energy/tools/model.py, written from the sources and the decisions, not from the formula text; every conformance case agrees with it

conformance: A Python, Rust or other implementation of spec.md must reproduce every entry of 'cases' (inputs inside the sheet's input rules). 'outside_rule_cases' show what the sheet itself does with inputs its rules reject (a paste that replaces a cell's rule, a value already in a cell when its rule was added, or a value written by a script can still reach the formulas); spec.md section 8 asks implementations to reject those inputs, so they need not reproduce them.

compare.numbers: relative difference at most 1e-12 (Python floats; the sheet shows 15 significant digits)

inputs.O1: selection (one of the 21 requirement names in s02 row 2)
inputs.E3: expected mature body weight, kg (number 0.5-150, or null = blank)
inputs.G3: number of puppies nursing (whole number 0-20, or null = blank)
inputs.K3: week of lactation (whole number 0-7, or null = blank)
inputs.M3: life stage (one of the 9 list items, or null = blank, read as None; spaces trimmed and case ignored as Sheets TRIM and = do)
inputs.B4: type of adult dog (B4 list item)
inputs.D4: type of adult cat (D4 list item)
inputs.K4: energy intake entered in place of the calculated requirement, kcal/day (number 10-30,000, or null = blank)

outputs.G4: the selected requirement's daily energy minimum (kcal/day), or the message it shows
outputs.C11: the energy minimum used on the Standards tab: K4 when it is a number above 0, else G4
outputs.C11_highlighted: whether the 1f C rule (C11 is not a number) shows C11 in yellow on red

messages: Standards Sheet Needs A Life Stage This Selection Covers
Standards Sheet Needs Lactation Wk & Puppy #
No NRC/FEDIAF Estimate After Lactation Wk 4: Use K4
Expected Mature BW Must Be At Least Current BW
Standards Sheet Needs Lactation Wk & Kitten #
Expected Mature BW in Standards Sheet Needed
No Dog Type Selection on Standards Sheet
No Cat Type Selection on Standards Sheet

tags.stale-inputs: a week and puppies entered outside lactation are ignored
tags.intake-in-K4: an intake in K4 replaces the value or message
tags.source-example: a figure printed in a source
tags.bw-vs-e3: batch 8c A: BW against the expected mature BW, inside the rules
tags.near-zero-point: around 1.88 x E3, where FEDIAF's puppy equation would reach 0, and B3 = E3
tags.m3-variant: M3 typed with other capitals or extra spaces
tags.bw-edge: B3 at the rule's limits (0.05, 150 kg)

other_inputs: G10 (caloric restriction) and G130 do not change row 4; they are blank in every case.

s02!Y4: Standards Sheet Needs A Life Stage This Selection Covers
